name: meltflex
description: AI interior design and 3D — restyle rooms, place furniture, stage spaces, and build 3D models and explorable 3D worlds from a photo.
long_description: MeltFlex AI turns a room photo into a photorealistic redesign, directly from Claude. Restyle rooms, place specific furniture, swap floors, walls, stairs, doors and windows, redesign kitchens, bathrooms, facades and gardens, and turn 3D drafts into photos — with quality levels, red-region edits and batches of variations. Also animates a still into a cinematic video walkthrough, converts a 2D floorplan into a 3D model, turns one furniture photo into a textured GLB 3D model, and turns a room photo into an explorable 3D world with a hosted viewer link. Tools: generate_interior, generate_video, floorplan_to_3d, furniture_to_3d, generate_world and check_credits. Requires a MeltFlex API key (any active subscription); each generation is billed to your own account credits.

tools.name: generate_interior
tools.description: Restyle or redesign a room from a photo and save the result to disk. Prompt-driven, so it covers the whole suite: interiors, floors, walls, exteriors, kitchens and more (10 credits per image; lite −2, pro +5; up to 3 variations).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Animate a still into a cinematic walkthrough MP4 with Veo 3.1 (100 credits for 4s, 150 for 8s).

tools.name: floorplan_to_3d
tools.description: Convert a 2D floorplan image into a downloadable GLB 3D model (100 credits).

tools.name: furniture_to_3d
tools.description: Turn one furniture photo into a textured GLB 3D model plus USDZ/FBX/OBJ links (75 credits, about 2–3 minutes).

tools.name: generate_world
tools.description: Turn a room photo or render into an explorable 3D world: .spz splat saved to disk plus a hosted viewer link (30 credits draft, 200 hd).

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show the account's MeltFlex credit balance and per-operation costs.

api_key.title: MeltFlex API Key
api_key.description: Your mf_sk_ API key from meltflexai.com/settings (requires an active subscription).
